messages:
Marta (PM): Quick: final compact GA gate for predictor pipeline. Need single-owner checklist for SLA text, runbook/rollback, week-1 oncall, alert thresholds, and promo billing. Goal: ship Friday if green.

Eli (SRE): SLA draft: 99.9% monthly, p95 <= 120ms, p99 <= 400ms. Operational fallback: if queue_time >200ms for 2m or error_rate >1% for 5m -> route to small-fallback-model and page oncall. I'll own infra checklist and fallback config.

Jess (Docs): API + examples done. I'll finish the runbook (escalation steps + rollback CLI) by tomorrow AM. Need Eli to confirm the exact failover CLI snippet.

Sanjay (Sales): Sales asks for a 10% launch promo for 60 days, limited to 20 named accounts. Finance OK with capped spend. I'll own promo list and billing codes; need product signoff.

Dana (Product Ops): Monitoring minimums: prompt_regression_rate by prompt-set, token_cost_per_request, model_error_rate by version, and nightly canary smoke. Ops-bot can schedule it. I'll own alerts and dashboards.

Carla (Legal): Any SLA exceptions (eg HIPAA customer) require a signed addendum/DPA. Legal will draft template; no verbal approvals.

Ops-bot: Nightly canary smoke scheduled 03:30 UTC. Failures post to #eng-sre and the rollout dashboard.

Marta (PM): Owners recap: Eli -> SRE; Jess -> Docs; Sanjay -> Sales/promo; Dana -> Monitoring; Carla -> Legal. I'll assemble the checklist and call "Ready to Ship" once all report green. Drop any last blockers here. :rocket:
